# omada_alg (Resource)

Manages the gateway's Application Layer Gateway (ALG) helpers for FTP, H.323, PPTP, IPsec and SIP.

This is a singleton per site — import it with the site name rather than creating it. Attributes left unset are not written and keep whatever the controller already has.

Note that SIP ALG is a frequent cause of VoIP problems; many deployments are better off with `sip = false` and NAT traversal handled by the endpoints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Application Layer Gateway helpers on the gateway.
#
# SIP ALG is left off deliberately: it rewrites addresses inside SIP payloads
# and is a common cause of one-way audio and dropped VoIP registrations. Modern
# SIP endpoints handle NAT traversal themselves.
resource "omada_alg" "this" {
  ftp       = true
  ftp_ports = [21]
  h323      = true
  pptp      = true
  ip_sec    = true

  sip = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ftp` (Boolean) FTP ALG.
- `ftp_ports` (List of Number) TCP ports the FTP ALG inspects. Controller default is `[21]`.
- `h323` (Boolean) H.323 ALG (legacy video conferencing).
- `ip_sec` (Boolean) IPsec pass-through.
- `pptp` (Boolean) PPTP pass-through.
- `sip` (Boolean) SIP ALG. Often best left disabled — see the resource description.
- `sip_direct_media` (Boolean) Allow direct SIP media between endpoints.
- `sip_direct_signaling` (Boolean) Allow direct SIP signalling between endpoints.
- `sip_media_timeout` (Number) SIP media timeout (seconds).
- `sip_ports` (List of Number) Ports the SIP ALG inspects. Controller default is `[5060, 5061]`.
- `sip_signaling_timeout` (Number) SIP signalling timeout (seconds).
- `sip_tcp` (Boolean) Inspect SIP over TCP.
- `sip_timeout` (Boolean) Apply the SIP signalling/media timeouts below.
- `sip_udp` (Boolean) Inspect SIP over UDP.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the primary site. Changing forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The site ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# ALG settings are a singleton per site — import by site name.
terraform import omada_alg.this Home
```
